decisions.why: Pessaries for pelvic health and prolapses—Dr Arabin Non-Perforated and Perforated Cube Pessaries, plus pelvic floor stimulators.
Spans walking aids (Alerta three-wheel and four-wheel walkers) and daily living aids (HipSaver hip protectors, Adult Bibs).
Non-specialist monitoring devices—Beurer BP monitors, weighing scales, thermometers.
